content.title: Arnold Barboza Jr vs Kenneth Sims Jr: Live streaming results and updates, how to watch, start time
content.text: Arnold Barboza Jr and Kenneth Sims Jr will both jump up to the welterweight division tonight, squaring off in the 12-round main event of a Golden Boy show from Anaheim.Bad Left Hook will be here with live results, updates, and scoring in the comments section, with Wil Esco on the call for us this evening.Barboza (32-1, 11 KO) is coming off of a loss to Teofimo Lopez in what turned out to be the LA native’s final fight at 140, and now faces Sims (22-3-1, 8 KO), a tricky veteran out of Chicago who could be a rough welcome to 147.Two world champions are also in action, as Oscar Collazo defends his WBO and WBA 105 lb titles against Jesus Haro, and undisputed flyweight queen Gabriela Fundora takes on Viviana Ruiz for the WBC, WBA, IBF, and WBO belts, plus more action on the five-fight main card.How to watch Barboza Jr vs Sims JrStart time: 8:00 pm ETStreaming: DAZN (subscription)Location: Honda Center - Anaheim, CABarboza Jr vs Sims Jr live resultsArnold Barboza Jr def. Kenneth Sims Jr by unanimous decision (117-111, 118-110, 120-108)Oscar Collazo def. Jesus Haro by TKO (3:00 Round 6)Alexis Rocha def. Joseph Diaz Jr by unanimous decision (97-93, 98-92, 100-90)Gabriela Fundora def. Viviana Ruiz by TKO (1:25 of Round 6)Joel Iriarte def.
